model_assumptions.root_rule: Highest source design-flow duct segment, tie lowest IFC id; an assumed ideal pressure boundary, not identified 302PF01 or misassigned 307TK device.
model_assumptions.service_rule: All 158 source-group terminals are assumed to require their full source design demand simultaneously. No rescaling to the unrelated or unverified 3.6 m3/s fan schedule.
model_assumptions.generation_rule: Declare engineering-like nominal constants, finite counterfactual diameter options, demand stress levels and carbon-factor scenarios before the conditional calculation. Do not change them after seeing favorable or infeasible outcomes.
model_assumptions.pressure_boundary: Ideal controllable pressure source meeting the model critical-path loss with constant assumed efficiency and ideal balancing. No actual fan curve, stable operating point or 302PF01 capability is inferred.
model_assumptions.local_loss_rule: Positive source design pressure and flow records calibrate quadratic flow scaling; missing records use disclosed component-class coefficients. Coefficients do not represent product qualification. Counterfactual section changes also require a velocity-squared scaling assumption.
model_assumptions.sizing_boundary: Circular counterfactual diameter rules within an assumed 1.5-times source-diameter envelope; source rectangular shape stays unchanged. Envelope is not a certified clash-free domain.
model_assumptions.carbon_boundary: Duct shell A1-A3 and declared duct replacement production only, plus ideal-source electricity B6. Fan manufacture, fittings, insulation, supports, installation, other replacements and end-of-life are excluded. No full-system LCA or field savings claim.
replacement_requirements: Native service/port topology and real source boundary
Applicable fan/control curves and operating schedule
Diameter-specific wall gauges and installation envelopes
Product EPD and region/year grid factors
claim_limits: Conditional real-source model, not field validation
Finite graph-derived path trees, not continuous-route optimality
Paired design variants of one source project, not independent buildings
All negative, disconnected, unsupported-regime and no-selection cases must remain visible
